title: The plate, the dock and the carried wipe

aliases.name: Plate, Ken Burns, the dock lands, the wipe carries the light

members.role: the bare plate is the world the claim is made on - no ledger page, so the card has a room to land in
the same plate carries its own Ken Burns push and drift, so the room is never still under the card
the evidence dock lands on that plate as a still image card
the card's payload is a chart surface - the claim's figure, not a photograph
the badge rail stamps the claim's qualification 2.05 s after the card lands (all 15 Steel fires carry one; optional because a bare card is legal)
the hard-edge wipe carries the card's light off the plate and reveals the next room under it

does: A chart card lands on a Ken Burns plate, its badge stamps, and the whole room is carried off by a right-hand wipe - the window runs to 31 s because the wipe waits for the plate's whole claim.
